name: SparkFun Thing Plus Matter - MGM240P
description: Silicon Labs MGM240P (EFR32MG24) Thing Plus for Matter over Thread, Zigbee and BLE 5.3 with Qwiic, microSD and LiPo charger; retired by SparkFun but a handy Matter dev board.
notes: SparkFun has retired this product (no longer sold new); the price shown is its last retail price.
MGM240P module has an integrated antenna; 1536 KB flash / 256 KB RAM; 2x5 1.27 mm SWD/PTI pads for a J-Link.
MAX17048 fuel gauge, 500 mA MCP73831 charger, microSD socket; header labels derived from SparkFun's Eagle files.
